Before making cross-project claims about this GitHub portfolio, use [PORTFOLIO_ORIENTATION.md](../PORTFOLIO_ORIENTATION.md) as the semantic orientation layer and [README.md](../README.md) as the public lab entry point.

Then inspect the canonical README or authority file of every named repository before making local judgments.

Do not infer project identity from repository names, old chats, recurring architecture terms, or one component. Shared words such as provenance, evidence, authority, canonical, append-only, or human review do not establish a shared ontology, runtime, or merger target.

If canonical sources are missing or contradictory, report **insufficient orientation** instead of guessing.

TRACE defines the provider-neutral durable onboarding and handoff protocol; its AI_ONBOARDING.md is the reference for cross-AI repository entry.
